items.title: Taco Bell’s Plan to Win Back Customers After Cyclospora Illness Outbreak
items.summary: Taco Bell has a battle plan to bring back customers after a parasitic outbreak was linked to lettuce served at its restaurants.  The plan includes $1 Mexican Pizzas and limited-time offers such as butter chicken tacos.  While health authorities linked an outbreak of cyclospora-related illnesses to product giant Taylor Farms, the fast-food standout has been hurt by people reporting explosive diarrhea and stomach cramping after dining at the chain’s locations.

items.title: Fast-Casual Chain Tops Buy Point, While Lettuce Crisis Fades For Taco Bell. Starbucks Is Turning Around.
items.summary: Better-than-expected earnings sent Chipotle Mexican Grill past a buy point Thursday while Yum Brands seemed to be overcoming a lettuce-linked illness that hurt its Taco Bell chain.  Starbucks showed signs its turnaround was taking effect.  Chipotle shares jumped more than 12% to the highest level since early February.
